move: glass header stretches open like a drop, items stagger in, highlight slides, sucks shut
how: A 300px frosted glass card 76px tall shows 'Menu' with a chevron over an ocean image and two drifting blurred orbs (3s yoyo sine). Cursor arrives with power3.out in the first 10% of 6s. Press at 0.7s: card scales 0.97, then at 0.82s its height tweens past the open size (+26px) with expo.out over 0.55s and settles back to OPEN with elastic.out(1,0.5) while the chevron rotates 180 with back.out(2) and four items rise from y -18 / scale 0.94 with back.out(1.8) staggered 0.07s. A translucent highlight then follows the cursor down the list: each move is expo.out 0.45s with a scaleY 1.3 stretch snapped back by elastic.out(1,0.4). At 3.9s the cursor returns to the header, presses at 4.5s (75%), items drop away power3.in staggered from the end, height collapses to 76 with expo.inOut over 0.6s, a scaleY 0.94 dip and elastic recovery sells the suck-back, chevron unwinds, and the cursor exits by 5.8s.
adapt: Change the header text, item labels and icons, background and orb colours; OPEN is computed from item count and heights so more items just work. Keep the expo.out overshoot plus elastic settle on open and the from-end stagger on close.
port: mount(el, shot) builds bg, orbs, menu (head, hl, list items) and cursor inside el. animate returns the timeline with open press at 0.117D, items 0.158D, highlight hops at 0.283D / 0.383D / 0.5D, close press 0.75D, collapse 0.783D. Height is tweened in px so OPEN must be computed from the built items; scope selectors to el.
caveats: height tween on the container triggers layout every frame
